fusions.name: Splitting Tines
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. Hurls a stinger that deals 8 damage, then forks to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 100% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Both Ways
fusions.desc: Looses a narrow cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 40% chance of [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Extended Haft
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 40% further. A line of stingers fights beside you for 12 seconds, striking for 4 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Twofold Payoff
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next 2 spells deal 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
